quests.name: Ashes on the River
quests.summary: Something is coming down the river into Brightwater, and the Queen's stolen heart-stone may be tied to it.

stages.text: The town bell is ringing over Brightwater. Warden Hollis says dead men were seen walking in the river at dawn.
The briars came down the river from the west, from the millrace of the old mill. The miller has not been seen in a fortnight.
stages.objective: Search the old mill west of town

stages.text: There is a trapdoor under the mill floor, and something cold is breathing below it.
In the miller's strongbox: a chip of the Queen's heart-stone, and a letter sealed with a moth.
stages.objective: Show Warden Hollis what you found

quests.name: Rats in the Cellar
quests.summary: Pell the innkeeper has a scratching in his cellar he swears is rats.

stages.text: Something is scratching in the Drowned Lantern's cellar.
Rats. Big ones. Enough of them. Pell will want to know.
stages.objective: Tell Pell the cellar is clear

quests.name: The Bog Witch's Bargain
quests.summary: Mother Sedge of Sallowfen wants a cold thorn from the thing in the mill.

stages.text: Mother Sedge wants a blackbriar thorn, still cold, from the brute in the mill.
stages.objective: Bring Mother Sedge a blackbriar thorn

quests.name: The Grey Hunter
quests.summary: Lyra is hunting the briar-wolf that killed her brother.

stages.text: The Grey Hunter dens somewhere in Sallowfen, east of the docks along the towpath.
stages.objective: Find the Grey Hunter's tracks in Sallowfen

stages.text: Frost-crusted tracks lead to a hollow under a dead oak.
